def workday(start_dt, days, holidays):
    cur = to_date(start_dt)
    if cur is None:
        raise ValueError("Could not resolve WORKDAY start date")
    days = int(days)
    if days == 0:
        return cur
    step = 1 if days > 0 else -1
    remaining = abs(days)
    while remaining:
        cur += timedelta(days=step)
        if cur.weekday() < 5 and cur not in holidays:
            remaining -= 1
    return cur
